However, it exhibits characteristic AI artifacts in fine details: the paws/toes are ill-defined blobs or simple lines rather than distinct digits, and whiskers on the middle/right rabbits appear floating or unnaturally stiff. Boundaries between touching rabbits show slight fusion. These defects prevent a perfect authenticity score despite the strong overall composition.

Whiskers on middle and right rabbits float disconnected or look like drawn lines.
Slight boundary fusion where rabbits touch each other.
